pattern_signature: upstream timeout to idp.internal at :15 past the hour
summary: Known benign partner IdP batch sync at :15 past the hour causes a 60-90 second burst of 'upstream timeout to idp.internal' warnings and brief circuit-breaker half-open events in auth-service.
remediation_guidance: DO NOT page the auth team or roll back auth-service deployments when idp.internal timeouts occur at :15 and self-heal within 2 minutes. Verify whether p99 latency and error rates returned to baseline before investigating other services.

pattern_signature: PgBouncer PoolTimeout (active=100/100) following ORM query loop
summary: Checkout service shares a 100-connection PgBouncer pool. Any unbatched ORM query inside a per-item loop rapidly exhausts all 100 connections when checkout RPS exceeds 30 req/s.
remediation_guidance: Check recent checkout deployments within 5 minutes of PoolTimeout onset and inspect ORM queries in services/checkout/orders.py for N+1 SELECT patterns.
